optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Project Manager, Insurance Policy Administration Migration

professionalSummary.text: Owns a tranche's migration plan and reconciliation schedule under the insurer's delivery framework.
professionalSummary.witness: Project manager on a life and pensions insurer's policy administration migration for three years, owning the migration plans and reconciliation schedules of three product tranches under the insurer's delivery framework.

experienceHighlights.text: Prepares the weekly steering report and explains reconciliation breaks to the steering committee under questioning.
experienceHighlights.witness: Prepared the weekly steering report for each tranche and presented the reconciliation breaks to the steering committee; the committee minutes record the questions raised on each break and the explanations accepted across the thirty-one weekly sessions I presented.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Keeps vendor and policy operations dependencies moving through the framework's dependency log.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Kept the platform vendor and policy operations dependencies moving through the framework's dependency log, taking three vendor slips to the committee for escalation.

skills.text: Prepares go-live readiness, with the decision staying with the steering committee, and records own responsibility boundaries.
skills.witness: Prepared the go-live readiness review for each tranche; the go-live decision was the steering committee's, recorded on the review together with which checks were mine and which were policy operations'.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish the candidate's ownership of migration plans and reconciliation schedules, preparation of weekly steering reports, management of dependencies, and preparation of go-live readiness. They do not establish the candidate's reconciliation evidence documentation at closure.

decisionBoundary.statement: The materials establish the candidate's experience and responsibilities for the role, but further human review is required to determine suitability.
